title: Every Statue Dances When You Tell a Secret… Except Hers 🗿💃
description:
In this town, when you tell a REAL secret out loud, the nearest statue starts to DANCE! Dad's hidden chocolate, Mrs Lee's teddy bear, Mr Gomez's shower karaoke… every secret makes a statue boogie. But at the big talent show, our hero's juggling tricks all go wrong, and Lily's bragging doesn't make a single statue move. What happens when he finally tells the scariest secret of all? 🗿💃

A short, kid-friendly story about being brave, being honest, and sharing a secret with a friend.
